newsitem.title: USA: Brent crude catapults in late U.S. paper trading.
newsitem.headline: Brent crude catapults in late U.S. paper trading.

text.p: North Sea Brent crude catapulted in late U.S. paper trading in a flurry of late-day activity, traders said.
Four full boats of July Brent traded, once each at $18.64 and $18.70 and twice at $18.80 a barrel.
A string of partial cargoes traded between $18.64 and $18.80.
July Brent settled at $18.67 on London's IPE.
A full boat of August Brent changed hands at $18.84, up eight cents from the IPE settlement.
June/July traded twice at minus 10 cents and once at minus 11 cents, around steady with the day's earlier trades.
May/June was talked at at minus 22/18 cents, and July/August at minus 9/7 cents.
